I am troubled by the escalating violence in #Kazakhstan.

The government must respect the country’s constitutional institutions and the peoples’ right to peaceful protest. I urge all parties to exercise restraint and seek a peaceful resolution.

This month marks the 50th anniversary of the Older Americans Act Nutrition Program, which funds life-saving community programs like @_MealsOnWheels.

To celebrate, I thanked local #CA07 volunteers and joined Roy (a MoW volunteer) to deliver meals to seniors in Rancho Cordova. https://t.co/n4rUR37edw

I’m honored to receive the Humane Advocate Award from @HSLegFund for my work to protect animals from abuse and cruelty. 🐾

I will continue to push for the humane treatment of our animal friends. #HumaneAwards https://t.co/z1vdLTF9UJ

On #WorldRabiesDay, I'm introducing legislation to lower the costs of rabies vaccines for uninsured individuals.

High costs should never be a barrier for individuals seeking life-saving treatment.

https://t.co/cx9CtqrBur

Deeply saddened by the loss of former Defense Secretary Ash Carter.

Sec. Carter was a devoted public servant, educator, and leader who brought historic advances in the equal treatment of servicemembers to the United States Military. My thoughts are with his loved ones.

13 years ago, the Affordable Care Act was signed into law, extending health care coverage to millions of Americans.

As a doctor, I will continue to work to protect and strengthen this law and will fight any reckless attempts to strip away health care from Americans.

I’m proud to have earned a 100% rating from @HSLegFund for my work advocating for the humane treatment of animals.

As a proud member of the Congressional Animal Protection Caucus, I believe that we must treat all animals with respect and compassion. 🐶🐱 https://t.co/enoxEAfEcA

Wishing a happy National Doctor's Day to all our nation’s physicians! As an internal medicine doctor by training, I had the honor to care for patients alongside many talented and dedicated doctors.

Thank you for all you do to keep families safe and healthy. 🩺 https://t.co/Hu5wlEIJDC

As a physician, I believe personal health decisions should be made by patients and their doctors.

That's why I united my fellow physicians in Congress and OB-GYNs to denounce gov't intrusion in the exam room, which harms the patient-physician relationship and health outcomes. https://t.co/SLyPBZKgOy

Since the overturning of Roe, medical students have struggled to receive adequate training in reproductive care.

Today, I’m introducing a bill to expand access to training to ensure our future doctors can provide the best possible care to their patients.

https://t.co/jteQrycxJ1

As a doctor, I know that personal health decisions should be made between patients and their doctors, not extreme politicians.

That's why I will NEVER stop fighting for a woman's right to make her own health decisions, including access to full reproductive health care.

In the face of relentless attacks on women’s health care by Republicans across the country, today’s decision will eliminate barriers to contraceptive access, empower women to exercise autonomy over their family planning decisions, and improve the economic well-being of millions.

Are you a post-9/11 combat veteran who was discharged 10+ years ago?

If so, you may be eligible for free VA health care coverage made possible through the bipartisan PACT Act.

Open enrollment ends Sept. 30. See if you qualify and apply today: https://t.co/KYCmf4EeAw

There will be real consequences for the American people if our government experiences a long-term shutdown in three days:

❌Working families will lose access to nutrition assistance
❌Stalled research on diseases like cancer and Alzheimer’s
❌Servicemembers will not receive pay

Rabies is both fatal and completely preventable if treated quickly.

Today, on #WorldRabiesDay, I am re-introduced my bill to lower the cost of rabies treatment for Americans facing thousands of dollars in unexpected out-of-pocket costs. Read more below: https://t.co/lhCR8kTPhf

Enrollment season through @CoveredCA is now OPEN! 

Learn more about how you and your family can access affordable health coverage by visiting https://t.co/YMbyolO8ry now! https://t.co/jYsGHsKPmG

As a physician who has cared for patients with diabetes, I understand the excessive cost of life-saving insulin for American families.

That's why I proudly supported the Inflation Reduction Act, voting to cap insulin costs at $35/month for our nation's seniors. #WorldDiabetesDay

On #ThxBirthControl Day, I proudly stand with women nationwide in the ongoing fight for reproductive health care.

Amidst efforts by Republicans to restrict access to birth control, we must empower women to exercise autonomy over their futures - free from political interference.

BIG NEWS: A record 20M+ Americans have enrolled in health care coverage through the Affordable Care Act!

As a doctor, I know the importance of having access to quality & affordable health care. 

We must continue fighting to protect & strengthen the ACA. https://t.co/eRkDWsK1OP

NEWS: A record 21.2 million Americans have enrolled in health care coverage through the Affordable Care Act. 

We must strengthen and protect–– not weaken and repeal–– this vital program. 
https://t.co/UtHS4SMb8T

As a doctor and father, I am greatly concerned by this latest effort to criminalize reproductive health care. 

Women’s personal health care decisions should be made between her and her doctor, NOT by the government.   
https://t.co/oodI4oOoPH

That’s why I introduced legislation to lower the costs of rabies vaccines for uninsured individuals. 

High costs should never be a barrier for individuals seeking life-saving treatment. 

Read more about my bill ⬇️
https://t.co/lhCR8kTPhf

As a doctor, I know just how important it is for my patients to have access to quality and affordable health care.

Thanks to President Biden’s leadership, a record 21.3 million Americans signed up for health insurance through the Affordable Care Act. #SOTU2024

I voted for President Biden’s Inflation Reduction Act to lower health insurance premiums, cap insulin costs for seniors, and provide free recommended vaccines for Medicare patients. 

Instead of repealing this legislation, let’s build on it.

#SOTU2024

Four years into the COVID-19 pandemic, millions of Americans continue to struggle with Long COVID.

On International Long COVID Awareness Day, I reaffirm my commitment to funding research, treatment, and prevention strategies to #ConfrontLongCOVID.
